newsitem.title: SPAIN: FORECAST - Bank of Spain key rate seen unchanged - poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Bank of Spain key rate seen unchanged - poll.

text.p: Nine of 10 financial experts polled by Reuters said they expected the Bank of Spain to leave its key money market rate unchanged at 7.25 percent at its regular repurchase tender on Friday.
Just one of those polled in the survey conducted Wednesday and Thursday said the central bank might lower the interest rate by 25 basis points.
He reasoned that the central bank had more scope for a cut following the Bundesbank's decision in late August to reduce the repo rate to three percent from 3.30 percent.
But the others polled said the Bank of Spain would keep rates steady until the basic guidelines of the government's 1997 budget draft were made known.
The ruling conservatives must present the draft to parliament by month-end.
The Bank of Spain may also be reluctant to cut given an expected rise in August consumer prices, due for release on Friday after the tender, the analysts and dealers said.
On average the market is anticipating that the CPI will rise 3.9 percent in August year-on-year after 3.7 percent in July.
The central bank has cut rates five times this year, bringing it down to 7.25 percent from nine percent at the beginning of January.
